---
title: Versions & rollback
description: Every publish is saved. Restore any one.
sidebar: { order: 4 }
---

Every **Publish** creates a version with the time, the author and a summary (from the AI chat, or written by you).

**Versions** lists them all. For each one you can:
- **Preview** it without changing the live site.
- **Compare** it with the current version.
- **Restore** it. This creates a new version that copies the old one, so nothing is lost.

Versions cover the site's **files**. Database rows and uploaded files belong to the site and aren't rolled back.
